page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.64-512 is a flexible general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9J45 processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance configuration provides 64 physical dedicated CPU cores and 128 virtual CPUs through multithreading (two threads per core). Paired with 512.0 GB of system memory, the instance maintains a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB of memory per virtual CPU.

The instance does not include integrated local NVMe or ephemeral storage, requiring workloads to attach remote block storage volumes for persistent data. Accelerators are omitted from this configuration, with a GPU count of zero. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address for public-facing deployments and external communication.

From an architectural efficiency perspective, the VM.Standard.E6.Flex.64-512 offers high core and memory density within a single virtual instance. By relying entirely on remote storage, it optimizes infrastructure costs for operations that do not require low-latency local drives, avoiding the expense of bundled physical disks.

This server type is suitable for large-scale enterprise applications, high-concurrency web serving tiers, data extraction and transformation (ETL) pipelines, in-memory caches, distributed build and CI/CD systems, and relational or document databases utilizing external block storage.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.64-512 is a flexible, general-purpose compute instance built on the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9J45 processor running at 2.7 GHz. It allocates 64 dedicated physical cores, supporting 128 vCPUs via simultaneous multithreading, alongside 512.0 GB of system RAM. This delivers a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per virtual processor. The instance does not include local ephemeral storage disks or GPU acceleration, instead provisioning one complimentary public IPv4 address and relying on external block storage services for data persistence. Designed for resource-dense horizontal and vertical scaling, it eliminates the cost overhead of unneeded local disks while delivering robust CPU and memory capacity. VM.Standard.E6.Flex.64-512 is well matched for demanding enterprise applications, container orchestration hosts, ETL processing, distributed software compilation, and large relational databases.
